ex.t: There is hardly any time left.

explain.ko: 셀 수 없는 명사(information, advice, furniture, news)는 a/an을 붙이지 않고 복수형도 없습니다. 양은 some, any, much, a lot of, a piece of 등으로 나타냅니다. 셀 수 있는 복수명사에는 many, a few, several, a number of를 씁니다. each와 every 뒤에는 단수명사가, all 뒤에는 복수명사(또는 all the + 복수)가 옵니다. both는 둘 모두, either는 둘 중 하나, neither는 둘 다 아님을 나타냅니다. enough는 명사 앞에, hardly any는 거의 없음을 나타냅니다. 관사 없이 일반적인 것을 말하는 무관사도 알아 두세요(Information is power).
explain.en: Uncountable nouns (information, advice, furniture, news) take no a/an and have no plural; use some, any, much, a lot of or a piece of. Plural countable nouns take many, a few, several, a number of. Each and every take a singular noun; all takes a plural noun (or all the + plural). Both means two together, either one of two, neither none of two. Enough goes before a noun; hardly any means almost none. Use no article for general statements (Information is power).

notes.ko: advice, information, news는 항상 단수 동사와 씁니다. The news is good.
notes.en: Advice, information and news take a singular verb: The news is good.

notes.ko: a piece of advice처럼 단위어를 붙이면 셀 수 있습니다.
notes.en: Add a unit word to count them: a piece of advice.

notes.ko: every는 단수, all은 복수라는 점이 다릅니다.
notes.en: Every is singular but all is plural.

lines.t: All the furniture has come to the new house. Each room needed something and we bought enough.

lines.t: All the students in our class passed the exam. Each student received advice from the teacher, and many students also found information on the internet. But there was hardly any time, so nobody could play in the final week.

trans.ko: 우리 반 학생들은 모두 시험을 통과했어요. 각 학생은 선생님께 조언을 받았고, 많은 학생이 정보를 인터넷에서도 찾았어요. 하지만 시간이 거의 없어서 마지막 주에는 아무도 놀지 못했어요.

questions.q: Why couldn't anybody play in the final week?

prompt.ko: 셀 수 없는 명사와 한정사를 써서 요즘 겪은 일을 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences about something that happened recently, using uncountable nouns and determiners.

task.model: I bought some new furniture yesterday. The shop assistant gave me a lot of advice. Each room needed different things. I didn't have enough money, so I decided to buy a few things later.

model_trans.ko: 저는 어제 새 가구를 샀어요. 점원이 조언을 많이 해 줬어요. 각 방마다 필요한 물건이 달랐어요. 충분한 돈이 없어서 몇 가지는 다음에 사기로 했어요.
model_trans.en: I bought some new furniture yesterday. The shop assistant gave me a lot of advice. Each room needed different things. I didn't have enough money, so I decided to buy a few things later.
